text:
The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**, not $3,000. Expectation damages put him where full performance would have, so he gets the $20,000 price less the $5,000 he saved by not finishing, less the $1,000 resale proceeds he already received. The $3,000 property-value figure is the restitution measure, which is an alternative the builder would not choose here when expectation gives more.

CONFIDENCE: 70
